name: Rose's Cleaning Inc
tagline: Family- and woman-owned cleaning and organizing, run by Rose Santa Rita since 2008.
about: Rose started cleaning homes in 2006 and has owned the business since 2008. The company avoids "cleaning by the numbers" in favor of custom, hands-on service, and gives free estimates in person or by FaceTime or WhatsApp video. They also do professional organizing, and are registered to work on federal properties.
service_area: Boston area, South Shore and Cape Cod
policies: Fully licensed and insured in Massachusetts (as stated)
Free estimates in person or by video call
pricing_text: Not published. Free in-person or video estimates.

name: Sonia's Cleaning Services
tagline: The cleaning service you don't have to supervise. Same cleaner every visit, cleaning since 2002.
about: Owner Sonia Vasconcelos has been cleaning homes since 2002. Recurring clients get the same cleaner each visit with no contract, and if anything is missed, the team comes back for a free re-clean when it is reported within 24 hours. Regular cleans are a flat price per visit based on home size and how often; deep, move and post-construction cleans are billed by the hour.
service_area: Newton, Chestnut Hill, Brookline, Wellesley, Needham, Belmont, Dedham, plus MetroWest
policies: Free re-clean if reported within 24 hours
No contracts, change or cancel anytime
pricing_text: Flat price per visit for regular cleans and Airbnb turnovers. Hourly for deep, move and post-construction cleans. Recurring visits are discounted, and estimates are free.

quotes.quote: Her service is always of the highest standard.

quotes.quote: The team is very professional, responds quickly, and is on time!

about: Taskforce is an Everett-based company focused on high-quality recurring house cleaning. It reports more than 14 years of experience and over 16,000 cleanings. Technicians are vetted when hired, and the company holds IICRC cleaning-technician certification, a Nextdoor Neighborhood Faves listing and a Cleaning for a Reason partnership.

name: Moro Pro Cleaning
tagline: A cleaner home and more time for yourself. Melrose-based, serving Greater Boston and the North Shore.
about: Moro Pro Cleaning is based in Melrose. Customers can see an instant price and book online, with no contracts and easy rescheduling, and pay after the clean is finished. The company says it has more than 130 five-star reviews across Google and Thumbtack.
service_area: Melrose, Medford, Cambridge, Boston, North Shore
pricing_text: They show instant prices online through a calculator. Ask if Serve can show their starting prices here.

name: 247 Cleaning Boston
tagline: Detail-focused home cleaning with the same trusted team every visit.
about: 247 Cleaning Boston cleans homes and businesses across Greater Boston with eco-conscious products. The "247" stands for their commitment, not their hours. policies: Eco-friendly products, or yours on request

name: JMA Cleaning Services
tagline: Reliable, insured, detail-oriented cleaning for homes and businesses in Somerville and Boston.
about: JMA Cleaning Service works in Boston and Somerville with trained teams focused on "efficiency, safety, and consistent quality." They offer recurring or one-time home cleans, post-construction cleanups and office cleaning, and promise transparent pricing with clear estimates. Quotes are by phone or WhatsApp, and their site is in English and Portuguese.

tagline: Home cleaning and maid service across Metro Boston, from a team that started in Boston.

name: Maria By House Cleaning
tagline: Chelsea-based home and office cleaning, with customer service as the first priority.
about: Maria By House Cleaning is based on Broadway in Chelsea and says customer service is its number one priority. The team does regular, deep and move-in/move-out cleans for apartments and homes, plus offices, clinics and post-construction cleanups. They use steam for carpets, polishing, and products described as safe for families and pets.
policies: Products safe for families and pets

name: Taty Cleaning Services
tagline: Quincy-based home and office cleaning, with same-day or next-day availability.
about: Taty Cleaning Services is a Quincy company cleaning homes and businesses across Greater Boston. Their "vetted team" handles weekly, biweekly and monthly cleans, deep and move-in/move-out cleans, Airbnb turnovers and post-construction work. You can book online or ask for a free quote, often for the same or next day.

name: Luminos Cleaning Services
tagline: A family cleaning company serving the South Shore with natural, pet-friendly products.
about: Luminos is a family business with more than eight years of experience cleaning homes and businesses on the South Shore. They mainly use non-toxic, hypoallergenic, pet-friendly products and use stronger ones only when needed. They say they stick to the quoted price unless you change the job.
